vibe_rationale: Buenos Aires' main tattoo convention with a real community core, but a paid-stand expo-hall format with little wider culture programming.
fit_notes: Adult tattoo artists and collectors; skin-care and aftercare adjacency is real but niche, with no health-sector precedent recorded. Four suppliers are listed and stands are sold publicly, but there is no partnership page or contact. A 9 square metre stand is listed at ARS 1,500,000 including insurance, so the entry cost is modest. Argentina-based.
